SKYBUILD character asset
=======================
Author: Quaternius
Asset pack: Ultimate Platformer Pack / Platformer Game Kit (December 2021)
Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateplatformer.html
Official download: https://quaternius.itch.io/ultimate-platformer-pack
Downloaded: 2026-10-20
Original file: Ultimate Platformer Pack - Dec 2021/Character/glTF/Character.gltf
Local file: bunny.gltf (original glTF data, unchanged)

License: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0).
The author's pack page and itch.io page explicitly mark this pack CC0 and
allow use in commercial projects. No attribution or royalties required.
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

Runtime modifications in SKYBUILD:
- Per-player colors, scale, facing and matte material settings.
- Animation blending for idle, run, jumping, punching and being hit.
- Spring-driven additive body/head/ear motion and landing compression.

Three.js GLTFLoader, SkeletonUtils and BufferGeometryUtils are vendored
from three@0.170.0 under MIT, with local import paths adjusted.
See ../../THREE-LICENSE.txt.

Party Animals is a style/feel reference only. This project does not use
Party Animals models, animations, textures or proprietary game code.
